name: Goblincore

influenced_by: a reclaiming of "ugly" nature (mud, mushrooms, bugs)

places: TikTok/Tumblr; forest floor and pond imagery
garments: collected natural objects (shiny rocks, acorns) as jewelry
reacts_against: cottagecore's tidy, sunlit prettiness, celebrating the muddy, unglamorous and amphibian side of nature instead.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Clutter, dirt, flora, frogs, goblins, snails, mushrooms, candles, shiny jewels, bones, moss.
wiki_facts.key_colours: Earth tones such as dark green, light brown, dark brown, dark lime, black, and navy blue. (Sometimes)

findings: dark — about 43% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 76% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
